description: Each frame shows 26 letter blocks from a to z, left to right. Green letters remain in the search range, cyan highlights the target r, and light gray marks letters already excluded. In frames 2 through 5, an upward pointer labeled “Midpoint” marks the letter on the page just opened.

frames.announcement: The goal is to find a character whose pinyin begins with r. The initial range contains all 26 letters in order from a to z.
frames.explanation: The initial range contains all 26 letters from a to z. No page has been opened yet. The target r is cyan, and the other 25 letters are green.
frames.key_state: Step 1, initial state: search all letters from a through z for a character whose initial is r.
frames.title: Step 1: Set the search target and initial range

frames.announcement: Open the dictionary halfway through to the initial m. Since r follows m, discard the first half, a through m, narrowing the search to n through z.
frames.explanation: On the first turn, open the dictionary about halfway through. The pointer marks m. Since r comes after m, exclude a through m. They turn light gray. The remaining letters n through z stay in color, with r in cyan.
frames.key_state: Step 2: The midpoint is m. Since r comes after m, exclude a through m. The remaining range is n through z.
frames.title: Step 2: Open to m near the middle and discard the first half

frames.announcement: Open halfway through the remaining section to the initial t. Since r precedes t, discard the second half, t through z, narrowing the search to n through s.
frames.explanation: Open near the midpoint of n through z. The pointer marks t. Since r comes before t, exclude t through z. Letters a through m on the left and t through z on the right are now light gray. Only n through s remain in color, with r in cyan.
frames.key_state: Open halfway through the remaining range n through z to t. Since r precedes t, exclude t through z. The range is now n through s. Letters a through m on the left and t through z on the right have been excluded.
frames.title: Step 3: Open to t in the middle of the remaining range and discard the second half

frames.announcement: Open halfway through the remaining section to the initial p. Since r follows p, discard the first half, n through p. Only q, r, and s remain.
frames.explanation: Open near the midpoint of n through s. The pointer marks p. Since r comes after p, exclude n through p. Letters a through p on the left and t through z on the right are light gray. Only q, r, and s remain in color: q and s are green, and r is cyan.
frames.key_state: Open halfway through the remaining range n through s to p. Since r follows p, exclude n through p. Only q, r, and s remain. Letters a through p on the left and t through z on the right have been excluded.
frames.title: Step 4: Open to p in the middle of the remaining range and discard the first half again

frames.announcement: Open halfway through the remaining range q, r, s. The initial is r, so the dictionary search is complete.
frames.explanation: Open to the midpoint of the remaining range q, r, s. The pointer marks the target r. A character with initial r has been found, completing the search. This is step 5 and the fourth page turn. The frame still shows q and s in green and r in cyan, the range before this turn. Letters a through p and t through z remain light gray.
frames.key_state: Step 5 completes the search. The midpoint of the remaining range q, r, s is the target r.
frames.title: Step 5: Open to r in the middle and finish the search

summary: Find any character whose pinyin starts with r in a dictionary ordered alphabetically by pinyin. There are five frames. Step 1 establishes the initial range. Steps 2 through 5 each open the dictionary to a new page.
title: Binary search in a dictionary
